preshot_note: The P3 deploy is applied by the parent task after this run. Against the pre-P3 build the same script records baseline behavior (chat_langs row absent; /lang en works in-memory); re-run post-deploy to record the P3-verified state. The script hard-fails only on transport/registration breaks.

method.reply_readback: bot-authored replies are NOT readable via the Bot API getMessage (Bot API limitation, established by e2e-photo). Markers M1/M2 bracket each reply; between-bracket ids are probed and logged. Reply texts are human-verified in the live DM; machine verdict = webhook HTTP 200 + chat_langs DB row + ddi_pairs ground truth + getWebhookInfo (url + no last_error_message).
method.crafted_updates: bot_command entities emitted exactly as the Bot API does; posted to the live target with the production x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token.
